The '''Chronos Belt''' was an [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]] that [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] the [[Star/Legends|sun]] [[Velus]]. It was situated between the [[Velus system]]'s second and third [[Planet/Legends|planets]], [[Velusia/Legends|Velusia]] and [[Velumia]], respectively.<ref name="Core" /> The [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] belt, like the rest of its [[Star system/Legends|system]], was located in the [[Northern Dependencies/Legends|Northern Dependencies]] portion of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="AtlasCorr" /> The Chronos Belt and its star system were located along the [[Shawken Spur]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]], connecting them to the [[Shawken system/Legends|Shawken]] and [[Thokos system/Legends|Thokos systems]]. The Velus system, and therefore the Chronos Belt itself, was additionally connected by another hyperlane to the [[Scipio system/Legends|Scipio system]].<ref name="Routes" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Chronos Belt was mentioned in ''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]'', a [[2003]] [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] sourcebook for [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Core" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Velus [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the Chronos Belt, in grid square L-9.<ref name="AtlasCorr" />
